description:
You are an environmental scientist preparing a geospatial dataset for a South American biodiversity corridor funding proposal. The proposal scope is limited to countries in South America that have significant human development pressure — specifically those with total populations exceeding 5 million people, as smaller nations lack the scale of habitat fragmentation the study addresses.

Using gvSIG Desktop and the countries layer at /home/ga/gvsig_data/countries/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.shp, select all country features that satisfy both of the following conditions simultaneously:
  - CONTINENT field equals 'South America'
  - POP_EST field is greater than 5,000,000

Export only the selected features (not the entire dataset) as a new shapefile to /home/ga/gvsig_exports/south_america_major.shp. The exported file must contain only qualifying countries, with all original attribute fields preserved.
